scope: Engineering gates for potential sampling of this ideal disk only; not biological tolerances or a proof of a uniform continuum error bound.

justification.potential: 2% is a useful preliminary engineering accuracy target, substantially tighter than the point-source error near a disk. It is not a stimulation-threshold tolerance.
justification.convergence: Last mesh and domain changes each below 1% reserve margin within the 2% total benchmark target; independent benchmark is still required.
justification.flux: P1 gradients converge slowly at a mixed-boundary sharp edge; 5% raw integrated current tolerance supplements the near-machine-precision conservative weak flux check. Gradient fields are not exported.
justification.export: Float32 nodal serialization plus identical P1 interpolation should incur only rounding error. Absolute tolerance protects comparisons near zero.
justification.neuron_delta: Neighbor differences use 5% plus 1 V/A (=1 microvolt at 1 microamp) to avoid meaningless relative errors near a zero difference. This verifies interface spatial variation only.
justification.rim: The same 2% potential threshold is recorded diagnostically for points inside the predeclared excluded rim tube of radius 0.02a. Failures remain in results; passing points do not expand the accepted region.
